name: Technology of Industrial Fabric Care
description: Why is holistic fabric-care a technology? Types of fabric-care. Focus on institutional fabric-care. Different types of fabric-care for different fibres. Typical wash-cycle. Factors determining cleaning efficiency. Overview of chemicals and machinery used in institutional fabric-care. Overview of fabric-care in hospitality and hospitals. Handling infected textiles in hospitals. Automation in fabric-care industry. Latest dry-cleaning technologies. How to ensure eco-friendly operations in institutional fabric-care. Latest trends in laundries: wet cleaning, ozone laundry.
